title: Pepper and Salad Italian Adventure
description: A delicious and easy to make Italian-inspired dish that combines the flavors of pepper and salad with a hint of adventure.
instructions: Cut the pepper into bite-sized pieces and place on a baking sheet.
Drizzle the adventurous with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Roast the pepper in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
In a large bowl, combine the salad and roasted pepper.
Toss to combine and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional adventurous if desired.
